title: LOGOS ASF — TR-06A Evaluation Report
description: Constitutional contract for one metadata-only evaluation run against one registered model/adaptor candidate. TR-06A reports evaluate governance metadata, provenance completeness, and structural invariants. They do not evaluate live model behavior. promotion_blocked is always true. promotion_decision_emitted is always false.

evaluation_report_id.description: Deterministic identifier for this report. Format: ER-<sha256[:16]>. Stable for the same candidate/gate/evidence.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of report creation.

candidate_artifact_id.description: The model_artifact_id (MA-*) from the TR-05 model registry that this report evaluates.

candidate_lineage_record_id.description: The lineage_record_id (LR-*) from the TR-05 lineage record for this candidate.

evaluation_gate.description: Which evaluation gate was run. Each gate targets a specific governance or provenance concern.

result.description: Gate outcome. pass=metadata check satisfied. fail=metadata check failed. block=hard governance violation detected. not_evaluated=gate cannot be evaluated from metadata alone (e.g. requires live inference or missing context).

requires_live_inference.description: Whether this gate requires model inference to produce a meaningful result. TR-06A gate stubs set this to false. Future live behavioral eval gates (TR-06B/06C) may set this to true.

metadata_only.description: Always true for TR-06A reports. TR-06A evaluates metadata, provenance, and structural governance invariants only.

evidence.description: Gate-specific evidence dict. Content varies by evaluation_gate. Contains the field values and flags inspected during evaluation.

promotion_blocked.description: Always true. TR-06A cannot emit a promotion decision or unblock a candidate.

promotion_decision_emitted.description: Always false. TR-06A never emits a promotion decision.

operator_review_required.description: Always true. Operator review is required before any promotion decision.

evaluated_by.description: Identifier of the harness, operator, or system that produced this report.

notes.description: Free-text notes about this evaluation result.

x-invariants.promotion_blocked_const: promotion_blocked is const:true. TR-06A cannot promote, unblock, or modify promotion_status.
x-invariants.promotion_decision_never_emitted: promotion_decision_emitted is const:false. No promotion pathway is created by a TR-06A report.
x-invariants.metadata_only_const: metadata_only is const:true. TR-06A evaluates governance structure, provenance, and flags — not live model behavior.
x-invariants.live_inference_honesty: Any gate that cannot be fully evaluated from metadata must return result=not_evaluated with requires_live_inference=true. TR-06A gate stubs that operate solely on metadata set requires_live_inference=false.
x-invariants.tr06b_not_started: Live behavioral evaluation (TR-06B) and shadow/canary (TR-07) are not started here.
x-invariants.no_tr07: TR-07 shadow/canary evaluation is not started here.
x-invariants.no_weights: No model weights are read, created, or referenced by path in TR-06A.
x-invariants.no_training: No model training occurs in TR-06A.
x-invariants.no_store1: No Store 1 writes occur in TR-06A.
x-invariants.no_deployment: No runtime deployment occurs in TR-06A.
